shortDescription.en: The book introduces Oliver's childhood in the workhouse. Its discussion turns to his journey to London. Another section examines Fagin's group of thieves. The source also develops Nancy's difficult choices. A later passage addresses poverty and social injustice. Together, these subjects frame the book’s fiction focus.

en: The book begins with Oliver's childhood in the workhouse and then sets it beside his journey to London. Its sections give distinct attention to Fagin's group of thieves, tracing how these ideas or events enter the wider subject. The order places the first two topics before the more detailed discussion that follows.

Later material discusses Nancy's difficult choices and poverty and social injustice. These strands establish the book’s scope and help readers decide where to begin. The sequence of topics makes clear which questions or events receive sustained attention in the text.
fr: Le texte commence par Oliver's childhood in the workhouse, puis le rapproche de his journey to London. Ses sections accordent une attention particulière à Fagin's group of thieves et situent ces idées ou événements dans le sujet général. Cet ordre fait précéder la discussion détaillée par les deux premiers thèmes.

La suite traite de Nancy's difficult choices et de poverty and social injustice. Ces fils montrent l’étendue du livre et aident à choisir un point de départ. La progression indique les questions ou événements auxquels le texte accorde une attention soutenue.
de: Das Buch beginnt mit Oliver's childhood in the workhouse und stellt es neben his journey to London. Die ersten beiden Themen stehen vor der ausführlicheren Erörterung.

Spätere Teile behandeln Nancy's difficult choices und poverty and social injustice. Diese Stränge zeigen den Umfang des Buches und helfen bei der Wahl eines Einstiegs. Die Abfolge macht sichtbar, welchen Fragen oder Ereignissen der Text besondere Aufmerksamkeit schenkt.
es: El texto comienza con Oliver's childhood in the workhouse y después lo relaciona con his journey to London. Sus secciones prestan atención especial a Fagin's group of thieves y sitúan estas ideas o hechos en el tema general. Los dos primeros asuntos preceden el análisis más detallado.

Más adelante se tratan Nancy's difficult choices y poverty and social injustice. Estos hilos muestran el alcance del libro y ayudan a elegir por dónde empezar. La progresión indica las preguntas o los hechos que reciben atención sostenida.

it: Il testo inizia con Oliver's childhood in the workhouse e poi lo accosta a his journey to London. Le sue sezioni dedicano attenzione a Fagin's group of thieves e collocano queste idee o vicende nel tema più ampio. I primi due argomenti precedono l’esame più dettagliato.

Più avanti compaiono Nancy's difficult choices ed poverty and social injustice. Questi fili mostrano l’ampiezza del libro e aiutano a scegliere da dove iniziare. La sequenza indica le domande o gli eventi cui il testo dedica maggiore attenzione.
ro: Textul începe cu Oliver's childhood in the workhouse și îl pune apoi alături de his journey to London. Secțiunile sale acordă atenție lui Fagin's group of thieves și așază aceste idei sau întâmplări în tema mai largă. Primele două subiecte preced analiza mai detaliată.

Mai târziu apar Nancy's difficult choices și poverty and social injustice. Aceste fire arată întinderea cărții și ajută cititorul să aleagă de unde începe. Succesiunea arată întrebările sau întâmplările cărora textul le acordă atenție susținută.
pl: Tekst rozpoczyna się od Oliver's childhood in the workhouse, a następnie zestawia ten temat z his journey to London. Jego części poświęcają uwagę Fagin's group of thieves i umieszczają te idee lub wydarzenia w szerszym kontekście. Dwa pierwsze tematy poprzedzają bardziej szczegółowe omówienie.

Dalsze fragmenty omawiają Nancy's difficult choices i poverty and social injustice. Te wątki pokazują zakres książki i pomagają wybrać punkt wyjścia. Kolejność wskazuje pytania lub wydarzenia, którym tekst poświęca szczególną uwagę.
